confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Vienna price levels for a July 2026 peak-season window. It was not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors (meals, coffee, wine) are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely with season and event demand. Beer and cocktail are set from the local price relationship to restaurant meals, since direct knowledge of exact bar prices is weaker. The FX observation comes from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct page fetch, so the 16 Oct figure should be verified against the RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to Western and Central European capitals with similar tourism demand and price levels, adjusted for Vienna's higher summer hotel rates and its typically moderate restaurant prices relative to Munich.
